Each side of the Nukva in Atzilut is made of the name BON, since Atiktakes the Taamim de BON to make its Nukva, and they are the first five Sefirot in Keter de BON since every Sefira consists of ten. Also, it takes GAR from Sefirat Hochmaand the first four from Bina de BON, and all this is for Nukva. Also, it takes seven Ketarim for the above-mentioned Nukva, from the bottom seven de BON.
Arich takes the last five de Keter de BON for Nukva and Abba takes the bottom seven de Hochma de BON. Ima takes the bottom six de Bina de BON and ZON take all the bottom seven de BON, except for the Ketarim in them, which Atik took.
